content: To analyze the efficiency of sorting algorithms, we parameterize things based on the input size and consider time as a function of the size of elements being sorted. We aim for upper bounds on running time to provide guarantees to users, such as a program not running more than a certain amount of time. This information is useful for users in real-time settings and helps them understand how to use the program effectively.
